reviews.text: Cathy is a remarkable trainer. Her work with our 2 rescue pups have given us a foundation from which to better enjoy our time with them both inside and outside the home. Her best attribute may be her ability to train the trainers (aka pet owners) and tailoring the training program to the needs of both dog and human. She is an absolute joy to work with and could not be recommended any higher.
Cathy is the BEST! Patient, focused, clear training for my dog…and me as an owner. I have not worked with a trainer before and this was a really great experience all around.

I can't say enough good things about Cathy! Not only is she the best dog trainer I've ever worked with (and I've had several trainers with various dogs over the years), she's also one of the kindest and most genuine people I know.

Her training methods are kind, consistent, and incredibly effective. My rescue dog was extremely stubborn and difficult to manage, but after just five sessions with Cathy, the transformation has been remarkable. She now sits and stays on command, and while we're still working on leash training, the progress has been nothing short of miraculous. She went from pulling constantly and walking in every direction to calmly walking by my side. We continue to practice every day, and I'm confident that with consistency, I'll be able to take her anywhere.

Cathy's techniques remind me very much of Cesar Millan's approach—but without the exorbitant price tag. Her rates are extremely reasonable, and she is worth every single penny.

What truly sets Cathy apart is how deeply she cares about the dogs and their owners. You can see that she genuinely loves every dog she works with and is personally invested in helping both the dog and the owner succeed. That level of dedication is rare and makes all the difference.

Thank you, Cathy, for changing our lives! I couldn't recommend you more highly.

Cathy has exceeded any expectations my wife and I had with our pup Mabel and her training. She is extremely knowledgable and provides a great structure and learning techniques to train owners on how dogs think and react. It's really motivating to see that even after the first or second session, you could see behavioral changes already. But like any new skill, you need to keep consistent and make sure the dog understands you are the pack leader(s) and to stay dilgent.

Our Mabel really responded well to Cathy's instruction and learning techniques. We also learned an almost overwhelming amount of information that really has set us up for success going forward. Cathy is great about communication and session details and providing accompanied documenation to reinforce learning sessions. We look forward to having doggie social hours to keep Mabel engaged with other dogs without having to worry about occasional ignorant owners and thier misbehaving dogs in the public dog parks (not saying public dog parks aren't great nor all owners are ignorant).

We would not hesitate to recommend Cathy to other dog owners and feel the information we learned will serve us for the remainder of our Mabel's long life and our dog-parenting styles. For the price and service, you cannot go wrong with Cathy and can remain confident that she has you and your pup's best interests when implementing her regiment.

After interviewing with multiple dog trainers, we knew that Cathy was the perfect person for our family. In 5 weeks, our boy has become more confident and calm while still maintaining his goofy and fun puppy personality. He is a completely different dog when we go on walks now (for the better) and Cathy has helped my partner and I set Paulie up for success while giving us the tools that we need to be our most confident and best leaders for him.

I have already recommended Cathy to two friends of mine and I’d recommend her services to anyone looking for guidance and training resources. She also offers a doggy social that we’ll continue to go to. We are so grateful for Cathy’s Canines and we can’t say enough good things!

Thank you Cathy!! - Paulie, Reganne, and Anthony
Cathy is the best!  She’s calm, clear and assertive with both humans and dogs and had Bo in the palm of her hand right away!  I highly recommend her.

We had a great experience with our dog trainer. Our dog Jojo is an amazing dog, but with a few challenges. We’ve already seen real progress with “place,” leash walking, and helping her feel more comfortable and friendly around our son. The training was practical, tailored to our home, and actually works in real life. We Highly recommend Cathy, she was fantastic.

Amazing talent. A true “ dog whisperer “. Disciplinarian coupled with loving understanding. Gives you all you need . Do your homework and she will give you the building blocks for a great future with your dog.

I have had such a great experience with Cathy. This was the first dog I’ve ever trained and she gave me clear instructions and came to my house, in our space! It was hands on and Cathy is extremely knowledgeable and showed me step by step! I was able to email/text her with questions and concerns, she was always responsive.
Make sure you’re ready to do the work with your dog, it takes patience. A great benefit with the training & after, is that Cathy offers weekly socials to keep up with training and teaching your dog how to act!!

Cathy  is amazing. She started working with us when our boxer puppy was only 10 weeks old. She helped him and us gain confidence and necessary skills for making him a great pet for our family. Highly recommend Cathy!

I was referred to Cathy by a friend. My dog's behavior was getting out of hand - she was getting bossy and unruly (Chihuahua-mix). She is an older dog that I've had for 5 years. Cathy helped us get dialed in on walks and reestablish me as alpha in our house. She's calmed down when I bring her to the office and is more secure at home. Walks are so much more enjoyable for me now that I'm in control. Thank you, Cathy!
Cathy is great and really knows her stuff. She gave us a solid foundation to build from. Can't recommend enough!

Cathy is the best..She is so good as a dog trainer and has a true passion for what she does..She is very responsive getting back to you immediately and has calmed my anxiety more than once on what to do with my dogs..Like I said in the beginning..She is the Best!

Cathy is an amazing trainer.  Her knowledge of dog temperaments and their individual state of mind is extensive.  She was able to teach my little rescue as well as me, how to learn what we each needed to make our relationship perfect.  My little Daisy is a great companion, so sweet and well behaved … a true gift to our lives thanks to Cathy and her training expertise.  Cathy’s skills are immeasurable!  I truly believe every dog would benefit from her skilled training techniques.  Thank you Cathy!!

We cannot recommend Cathy enough for anyone looking for a dog trainer in the area! From the moment we met her, it was clear that dog training is Cathy's absolute passion. She goes above and beyond, investing herself completely in the relationship she builds not just with your dog, but with you as the owner.

In just five weeks with our 4-month-old boxer, Poppy, Cathy has worked wonders. We've established a consistent routine, mastered crate training, and Poppy now confidently executes basic commands like sit, stay, and come. Poppy now walks with incredible confidence and swagger on the leash and she has really come out of her shell to be a super social dog!

With so many training options out there, what truly separates Cathy is her unwavering commitment to helping you build a real, deep relationship with your dog. She doesn't just teach commands; she empowers you as the owner to take the lead and really is focused on building a lasting and healthy relationship with your dog. As an added bonus, her weekly puppy socials are something we look forward to every week. It's a fantastic opportunity for the dogs to interact without human interference, and we've seen Poppy's confidence blossom with each session.

Simply put, choosing Cathy has been one of the best decisions we've ever made for Poppy and our family. We feel part of every session, and watching Poppy’s progress has been so rewarding. She's a true gem and I highly recommend Cathy’s Canines!

Cathy did an amazing job with our mini schnauzer, Otto. He is a three-year old rescue, who was pretty well behaved, but definitely believed he was in charge of the house. I’m admittedly quite a softy with dogs (especially Otto), but Cathy taught my wife and me how to get his behavior in-line but also some fun games to stimulate his mind and increase our interactions with him. He barks at strangers far less when we’re on walks or when they come to the house. He patiently waits for his food dish to be filled or to be given a treat. He’s even learned (for the most part) to wait for one of us to cross the threshold of our house before he goes inside. After just five sessions, we’re shocked at how much he’s improved. Otto is remarkably stubborn, but Cathy is extremely helpful, and if you stick with her program, your dog will show quick changes for the better. Thank you for everything, Cathy! We all enjoyed working with you and can’t wait to report back on Otto’s further progress!

Cathy has been wonderful to work with. Our 1 year old dog Jack was afraid of noises and going outside, and with Cathy's guidance he is able to walk around the neighborhood with little to no trouble and is overall much less fearful and more confident.

She has also provided us with valuable tips and shown us how to be the "leaders of the pack", therefore making Jack feel much more secure at and away from home.

We still look forward to the weekly Socials and get lots of additional advice along the way. Thanks Cathy!!
Kathy was so great with my dog Buck, she knows how to get dogs to listen and he’s already been so much better on the leash and listening around the house!

Cathy did an amazing job helping us turn our unruly, reactive Boxer into a well-mannered dog. She is still a goofy, high strung dog but now walks nicely on a leash and is well behaved in the house. I did not realize how many of her bad behaviors (chewing,  barking, jumping, being pushy) were due to our lack of structure and boundaries. The techniques she uses are gentle and firm - all without aversive training methods (no shock or prong collars) which was important to me. 100% recommend!!

I have neve meet Cathy, but she talked with me on length and really helped me understand some things along with helpful ways to redirect my dog. IF she was closer i KNOW we'd have my adolescent pup in there with her.  Thank you so much Cathy! :)

Cathy is amazing! Our 5 year old Husky/Malamute loves to pull on the leash on walks (big surprise), and occasionally jumps when someone new walks in the front door. Cathy showed us training techniques that have really helped us be better dog parents, be more confident, and have helped Kona be a more chill dog. It is all about training the humans to understand how to be a good pack leader, and the dog to understand their place as well. Totally makes sense! Cathy's training sessions were SO worth it. They changed our house vibe for the better and are one of my highlights of 2024. Thank you, Cathy!

My puppy and I just completed 5 weeks of training where Cathy taught us very helpful techniques for a well-behaved puppy. She stresses progress not perfection, which is what I was looking for. Having her work individually with the puppy and me enabled us to learn more thoroughly. We had lots of things to practice each week, and we are still practicing. I love that she has weekly Puppy Social Hours (additional to the individual training) where we continue to learn and practice with other dogs around and at a reasonable price. Definitely check out Cathy's Canines!
Cathy is absolutely the best!  A wealth of knowledge, application, and patience.  She expertly advised and trained us and our shepherd/husky mix.  You won't be disappointed!  Call her today!

With Cathy's guidance, our 11 month-old pup is showing improvement in his daily walks, playing, resting, and even in his own confidence. I was convinced that every interaction with another dog was going to be ball of barking chaos. Thanks …

We feel very fortunate to have found Cathy’s Canines to help guide us through the training process with our new puppy!  From our first session, it was clear she knew what she was doing!  Her insight and knowledge of canine behavior was …

working with Cathy was absolutely perfect. She not only worked with our Cane Corso, she worked with my family and I to learn how to establish leadership and be the alpha. Now my walks with Lola are not her pulling me but me getting the exercise I need. I would highly recommend Cathy’s Canines for your dogs training.
